home.title: AI-powered comment management
home.subtitle: The project skeleton is running. Features will be added phase by phase.

login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to review and approve replies to your shop's comments and messages.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Start managing Fanpage comments with an AI assistant.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: If {email} can receive email, select the link in the message to activate your account.
checkEmail.bodyNoEmail: If your email address can receive email, select the link in the message to activate your account.
checkEmail.hint: Can't find it? Check your spam folder or resend. It may take a few minutes.
checkEmail.resent: Email sent again (if the address is valid). It may take a few minutes.

verify.successBody: Your account is ready. You can sign in now.
verify.errorBody: The link has expired or is not valid. Sign in to get a new verification email.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send instructions to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If this email has an account, we've sent instructions to reset the password. It may take a few minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password for your account. Every signed-in device will be signed out.
reset.invalidBody: The password reset link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

banners.resetDone: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

errors.invalidCredentials: Email or password is incorrect. Check them again, or reset your password if you forgot it.
errors.emailNotVerified: This email isn't verified yet. Open the verification email in your inbox, or resend it below.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait about {minutes} minutes, then try again.
errors.twoFactorRequired: This account needs a two-step verification code to sign in.
errors.emailInvalid: That email doesn't look right, for example name@company.com.
errors.passwordTooLong: Password can be at most 128 characters.
errors.passwordCommon: This password is too common and easy to guess. Choose a different one.
errors.passwordPwned: This password has appeared in data breaches. Choose a different one.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords don't match. Enter them again.
errors.nameInvalid: Enter your full name (up to 80 characters).
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Check the latest code in your authenticator app.
errors.invalidBackupCode: That backup code is not valid or was already used. Each code works once.
errors.twoFactorExpired: The verification session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.twoFactorRequiredNoDisable: Workspace owners and administrators must keep two-step verification on, so it cannot be turned off.

app.body: You are signed in to the workspace “{workspace}”. Connecting your Page comes in the next step.

panel.title: Reply to Fanpage comments and messages faster — you still decide.
panel.subtitle: The AI assistant drafts replies from your shop's knowledge base; staff review them before sending.
panel.humanInControl: AI only drafts; it sends on its own only when the shop owner turns that on.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone.
twoFactor.backupHint: Looks like xxxxx-xxxxx. Each code works once.

security.title: Account security
security.subtitle: Manage two-step verification and the devices signed in to your account.
security.requiredBanner: Workspace owners and administrators must turn on two-step verification. Turn it on now to keep using the app.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification (TOTP)
twoFactor.offBody: Add a second layer of protection: besides your password you need a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password...).
twoFactor.onBody: On. Each sign-in also needs a code from your authenticator app. If you lose your backup codes, generate new ones under “Regenerate backup codes” below.
twoFactor.passwordHint: Enter your password again to confirm it is you.
twoFactor.scanBody: Open your authenticator app, add an account and scan the code below.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for adding the account to an authenticator app
twoFactor.confirmLabel: The 6-digit code shown in the app
twoFactor.backupBody: Use them if you lose your phone. Each code works once and is shown only now. Keep them somewhere safe. If you lose them, you can generate new ones under “Regenerate backup codes”.
twoFactor.disableBody: Your account will be protected by the password only. All existing backup codes will be deleted.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.body: Your own sign-in sessions. If you see a device you do not recognize, sign it out and change your password.

create.title: Create your workspace
create.subtitle: A workspace is where your whole team handles the shop’s comments. You will be its Owner.
create.name: Workspace name
create.nameHint: For example your shop or brand name (1–80 characters).
create.languageHint: Used for emails to members and the workspace’s default content.
create.twoFactorNote: After creating it you need to turn on two-step verification (2FA). It is required for Owners to protect customer data.

errors.nameInvalid: The workspace name must be 1 to 80 characters.
errors.timezoneInvalid: Invalid time zone. Please choose one from the list.
errors.generic: Could not create the workspace. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.rateLimited: You have created too many workspaces in the last 24 hours. Please try again later.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Manage the people who work in the workspace “{workspace}”. Only Owners can see this page.

list.title: Member list
list.selfNote: You cannot change your own role or remove yourself.

actions.removeWarning: This person loses access immediately. To add them back you must invite them again.
actions.lastOwner: This is the last active Owner, so the role cannot be lowered and the member cannot be suspended or removed.

invite.title: Invite a member
invite.body: Send an invitation by email. The recipient must sign in (or sign up) with exactly this email. The link works once and expires in 7 days.
invite.email: Email of the person to invite
invite.roleHint: Owners have full access and must turn on two-step verification. Staff handle comments and messages.
invite.sent: If the email is valid, the invitation has been sent. You can follow it under “Pending invitations”.

errors.emailInvalid: The email format is not valid.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent too many invitations. Please try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.lastOwner: The workspace must always keep at least one active Owner.
errors.leaveLastOwner: You are the last active Owner. Promote another member to Owner (or delete the workspace) before leaving.
errors.invalid: The information is not valid. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.generic: Could not complete that. Please try again in a few minutes.

leave.title: Leave workspace
leave.subtitle: Leave the workspace “{workspace}”. You lose access immediately and can only return if you are invited again.
leave.warning: You will no longer see this workspace's comments, activity log or data. All Owners will receive an email saying you left.
leave.lastOwner: You are the last active Owner, so you cannot leave yet. Promote another member to Owner first.

card.title: You are invited to “{workspace}”
card.signedOut: Sign in or sign up with exactly the email that received the invitation to join.
card.signedIn: You are signed in. Accept the invitation to join this workspace.

invalid.title: This invitation cannot be used
invalid.body: The invitation may have expired, already been used or been revoked. Ask an Owner to send it again.

errors.invalid: This invitation cannot be accepted. It may have expired, been used or revoked, or the account you are signed in with is not the invited email. Check which email you are signed in with or ask an Owner to send it again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again in {minutes} minutes.
errors.generic: Could not complete that. Please try again in a few minutes.

bulk.shortcuts: Shortcuts: X select row · J/K move · H hide · Esc clear
bulk.confirmBody: These comments will be hidden from customers on the platform; each can be unhidden. AI never hides on its own.

reasons.not_applicable: {count} comments not applicable (already handled, being handled by a teammate, or gone).
reasons.not_hideable: {count} comments can't be hidden in their current state.
reasons.locked_by_other: {count} comments are being handled by a teammate.
reasons.channel_not_connected: {count} comments belong to a channel that isn't connected.
reasons.forbidden: {count} comments you aren't allowed to handle.
reasons.queue_unavailable: {count} comments couldn't send the hide request, please retry.
reasons.unavailable: {count} comments hit a temporary error, please retry.

rejections.too_many: Select at most {max} comments at a time.
rejections.unavailable: The system hit a temporary error, please retry.

empty.title: No comments yet
empty.body: New comments from your connected Pages will show up here.
empty.filteredBody: Try another tab or clear some filters.

detail.title: Comment details
detail.empty: Select a comment to see its details.
detail.isReply: This is a reply to another comment.
detail.redacted: The customer deleted this comment; its content and the commenter details were removed from the system.
detail.notFoundBody: The comment no longer exists or is not in this workspace.

error.title: Could not load the comment list
error.body: A temporary error occurred. Please reload in a few minutes.

lock.mine: You are handling this comment (2-minute soft lock, renewed while open).
lock.heldNamed: {name} is handling this comment (about {seconds}s left). View only.
lock.heldAnonymous: A teammate is handling this comment (about {seconds}s left). View only.

reply.placeholder: Type the reply to send to the customer…
reply.stateSlow: This is taking a while. Please reload the page in a few minutes.

blocked.lockedNamed: {name} is handling this comment, so you cannot reply yet.
blocked.lockedAnonymous: A teammate is handling this comment, so you cannot reply yet.
blocked.channelUnavailable: The channel is not connected, so replies cannot be sent. The workspace Owner needs to reconnect it.
blocked.notReplyable: This comment cannot be replied to right now.
blocked.deleted: The customer deleted this comment on the platform, so it cannot be replied to.

failures.too_long: The reply is too long (8000 characters max).
failures.not_replyable: This comment can no longer be replied to (already replied, hidden or being processed).
failures.locked_by_other: A teammate is handling this comment.
failures.channel_not_connected: The channel is not connected, so the reply cannot be sent.
failures.forbidden: You are not allowed to reply.
failures.queue_unavailable: Could not send right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
failures.unavailable: Could not send right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.tokenExpired: The channel connection expired. The workspace Owner needs to reconnect it.
errors.permission: The channel no longer has permission to reply. The workspace Owner needs to grant access again.
errors.blocked: The platform is temporarily blocking sends from this channel. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimit: The platform is rate-limiting requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unknown: It is unclear whether the reply was sent. Trying again checks first and will not send twice.
errors.recheckR1: The comment was already replied to or changed status, so it was not sent.
errors.recheckR2: The comment was hidden or merged, so it was not sent.
errors.recheckR3: The channel is disconnected or temporarily blocked from sending.
errors.connectorUnavailable: Could not reach the platform to send. Please try again later.
errors.actionUnsupported: This platform does not support replying to comments yet.
errors.windowExpired: The allowed time to reply to this comment has passed.
errors.textTooLong: The reply is longer than the platform allows.
errors.retriesExhausted: Tried several times but could not send. Please try again later.
errors.generic: Sending failed. Please try again later.

hide.stateHiding: Hiding the comment on the platform…
hide.stateUnhiding: Unhiding the comment on the platform…
hide.stateSlow: This is taking a while. Reload the page in a few minutes.

blocked.lockedNamed: {name} is working on this comment, so you cannot hide it yet.
blocked.lockedAnonymous: A teammate is working on this comment, so you cannot hide it yet.
blocked.channelUnavailable: The channel is not connected, so hiding or unhiding is not possible. The workspace owner needs to reconnect the channel.
blocked.notHideable: This comment cannot be hidden right now (it is being processed or a reply is being sent).

failures.not_hideable: This comment can no longer be hidden or unhidden (it is being processed, deleted or merged).
failures.locked_by_other: A teammate is working on this comment.
failures.channel_not_connected: The channel is not connected, so this could not be done.
failures.forbidden: You do not have permission to hide or unhide comments.
failures.queue_unavailable: Could not do this right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
failures.unavailable: Could not do this right now. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.tokenExpired: The channel connection has expired. The workspace owner needs to reconnect the channel.
errors.permission: The channel no longer has permission to hide comments. The workspace owner needs to grant it again.
errors.blocked: The platform is temporarily blocking actions from this channel. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimit: The platform is rate limiting requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unknown: It is unclear whether the platform received the request. You can safely try again; it will not duplicate anything.
errors.recheckH1: The customer deleted the comment or it was merged, so it was not hidden.
errors.recheckH2: The comment changed status, so it was not hidden.
errors.connectorUnavailable: Could not reach the platform. Please try again later.
errors.actionUnsupported: This platform does not support hiding or unhiding comments.
errors.windowExpired: The time allowed for acting on this comment has passed.
errors.retriesExhausted: Tried several times but could not complete it. Please try again later.
errors.generic: The action failed. Please try again later.

body.owner: The system cannot read or reply to comments on this channel for now. You (Owner) need to reconnect it.
body.staff: The system cannot read or reply to comments on this channel for now. Please ask the workspace Owner to reconnect it.

revoked.title: Channel access was revoked or disconnected: {names}.

body.owner: The channel stays unusable until you (Owner) grant access again and reconnect.
body.staff: The channel is unusable. Please ask the workspace Owner to grant access again and reconnect.

body.owner: The system is retrying. If it keeps failing, reconnect the channel.
body.staff: The system is retrying. If it keeps failing, please tell the workspace Owner.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Facebook Pages of workspace {workspace}. Only the workspace Owner can connect them.
channels.disabled: Facebook connection is not enabled for this environment.

list.title: Connected channels
list.noWebhook: Not receiving new comments (webhook not registered)

pick.title: Choose Pages to connect
pick.hint: This workspace can connect up to {limit} channels. You can only pick Pages you manage or moderate.
pick.empty: This Facebook account has no Pages that can be connected.
pick.noPermission: You do not manage or moderate this Page.

notice.partial: Connected {ok} Page(s); {bad} not finished (Page does not match the account, missing permission, or comment delivery could not be registered). Press Reconnect to retry.
notice.state: The connection session expired or is invalid. Press Connect Facebook to try again.
notice.denied: You cancelled granting access to Facebook. Nothing changed.
notice.error: Could not connect Facebook. Please try again in a few minutes.
notice.limit: This exceeds the channel limit of your current plan. Select fewer Pages or upgrade.
notice.unavailable: Facebook connection is being reconfigured. Please tell your system administrator.
notice.expiredSession: The Page selection session expired. Press Connect Facebook to start over.

subtitle.owner: Actions by members, AI and the system in this workspace. Read-only; entries cannot be edited or deleted.
subtitle.staff: Actions you performed yourself, including work the system did at your request. Read-only; entries cannot be edited or deleted.

systemOnBehalf.former: System (at the request of a former member)

empty.title: No log entries yet
empty.filteredBody: Try removing a filter or widening the date range.

detail.title: Log entry details
detail.empty: Select an entry to see its details.
detail.notFoundBody: This entry does not exist or you are not allowed to see it.
detail.noChanges: This entry has no before/after values.

error.title: Could not load the log
error.body: Something went wrong while loading. Please try again later.
